bins: date 0 one bin; later dates five equal-count bins sorted by current spot
test: C-C_hat differences of adjacent continuing-date errors; refined-grid change added to tolerance. Bonferroni two-sided normal test when expected positive inner payoffs >=30; otherwise bounded Hoeffding test (put payoff in [0,K], difference range <=4K). All sparse cells retained; normal statistics diagnostic only in sparse cells.
sparse_rule: Use expected terminal-positive count across bin times inner, from exact GBM conditional terminal distribution, as conservative sparsity diagnostic; all tests also report bounded Hoeffding gate, which is the acceptance gate to avoid relying on unverified normal tails.
centering: Conditional on entire outer path, each independent inner C_hat is unbiased for C; increment error = 1_continue(k+1)*(C_hat(k+1)-C(k+1)) -(C_hat(k)-C(k)); conditional expectation zero. Exact increment itself includes outer martingale tail noise. Grid refinement is numerical sensitivity, not certified error bound.

sizing.gate: absolute paired mean change < current outer SE for both policies at same doubling; no c/n correction
